summary.text: Scott Bowen is the Republican candidate for Texas House of Representatives District 129 in the November 3, 2026, general election, running against Democrat Albert Wittliff in a race with no incumbent.
According to his campaign website, Bowen is an engineer in the energy sector who served on the Clear Creek ISD Board of Trustees from 2019 through 2025.

paragraphs.text: His campaign website says Bowen is a lifelong resident of House District 129 who grew up in Clear Creek ISD schools and attended Clear Lake High School.
It says he earned a chemical engineering degree from Texas A&M University and an MBA from Rice University.
The site says Bowen has been a Harris County Republican precinct chair since 2014 and held party roles including Senate District 11 chair from 2015 to 2020.
It says he was elected to the Clear Creek ISD Board of Trustees in 2019, re-elected in 2022 and served through 2025.
The campaign's stated concerns include property taxes, internal enforcement of immigration laws and criminal justice enforcement in Harris County.
